messages:
maya: Quick idea — add a tiny "bookmark session" action in the route inspector header that captures current filters + model pins + sampling rate so PMs can share an exact telemetry snapshot. thoughts?

jamal: Love the ergonomics. main concern: payload size if we dump full filter trees. can we compress to ids + diff? :thinking_face: 

lucy: Agree with jamal. Also need to decide scoping: route-only vs route+model vs org. If we bundle model pins we should version the model id schema.

priya: We should include sampling metadata (sample rate, sampled_count) so cost previews are accurate. otherwise saved snapshots look cheaper than live.

maya: Good call. My mental payload prototype:
```json
{
  "scope": "route",          // route | route+model | org
  "route_id": "r-123",
  "model_ids": ["m-7", "m-8"],
  "filters": ["f:status=500","f:latency>200"],
  "sampling": {"rate": 0.02, "window_minutes": 60}
}
```

jamal: That looks fine. Implementation note: dont store expanded filter SQL, store normalized tokens so we can rehydrate on UI. Also backend API should validate model existence at save-time and store soft refs.

lucy: UX: where does this live? two options — (A) ephemeral session bookmarks in top-right toolbar, not shared by default; (B) saved snapshots like saved queries (shareable). We should support both with a toggle.

priya: Toggle sounds right. Default to ephemeral to avoid cluttering org-wide saved queries. But add explicit "publish" flow that runs a quick telemetry dry-run and warns if cost delta > 2x.

maya: Can we do the dry-run cheaply? maybe run a sampling-adjusted estimate using stored counters instead of full query. If estimate > threshold show modal.

jamal: Yup, we can do cheap estimate using precomputed histograms per-route+model. Need API: POST /api/console/session-bookmarks -> returns {id, estimate_tokens, warnings}. Example:
```http
POST /api/v1/console/session-bookmarks
Content-Type: application/json

{...payload...}
```
Response 
```json
{ "id": "sb-22", "estimate_tokens": 12345, "warnings": ["estimate 3.4x baseline"] }
```

lucy: Also add telemetry overlay option when opening a bookmark: show sample coverage (1000 of 50k) and note that charts are sampled. small badge on charts.

priya: Ops note — when published, we should create an immutable snapshot with pointers to exact model versions (hashes) to avoid drift during rollouts. store model_version_id string.

maya: Rollout plan: start as feature-flag in console for beta orgs, collect usage + false-positive warnings for 2 weeks, then default opt-in. Canary teams: analytics and demo apps.

ops-bot: deploy queued for canary flag rollout to console-beta at 2024-06-05T17:10:00Z :rocket:

jamal: One last API contract detail — allow GET /api/session-bookmarks/:id?hydrate=true to return rehydrated filter expressions for UI, but keep it behind permission check.

lucy: UX followup: add quick-copy link for ephemeral sessions so PMs can paste into slack without publishing.

maya: Perfect. i'll draft a small RFC with API contract + UX mock and ping infra for histogram endpoints. thanks all :heart:
